name: Site work & earthwork
notes: Earthwork unit prices are anchored on DOT weighted-average bid prices (FDOT statewide Sep 2025-Aug 2026, MDT 2025, ArDOT Jun 2025-Jun 2026). DOT clearing & grubbing per acre is highway right-of-way work (narrow, linear, often urban, with disposal and removals bundled) and runs far above private pad clearing; it is kept as evidence but not used as the mid. The all-in site-development items are assembled from this file plus the paving, utilities, stormwater and landscaping blocks and are therefore derived.

items.name: Clearing & grubbing (wooded to lightly wooded, incl. disposal)

cost.method: DOT evidence spans $2,812/acre (MDT 2025, rural, 19.9 ac, e2) to $15,395/acre (FDOT selective C&G, trees to remain) and $48,456/acre (FDOT full C&G, 225 contracts, e1). The FDOT full item is highway R/W work that bundles removal of obstructions, small odd-shaped areas and urban disposal, so it is treated as an outlier for private sites. Mid $6,000 = geometric middle of the rural MDT price and the FDOT selective price; low $2,500 = open/brushy land (≈MDT); high $15,000 = heavily wooded with off-site disposal (≈FDOT selective).

items.notes: Per acre actually cleared. Open pasture/farmland: use the low end or $0. Excludes demolition of structures and pavement (see demolition-remediation block).

items.name: Mass / rough grading (balanced cut-fill, incl. fine grading of pad)

cost.method: Unit prices: FDOT regular excavation $6.81/CY and embankment $12.63/CY (e3); MDT unclassified excavation $8.17/CY (e4); ArDOT unclassified excavation $18.51/CY (e5). Typical commercial pad moves 1,000-2,500 CY of cut per acre (avg 0.6-1.5 ft) at ~$7-$10/CY = $7k-$25k, plus fine grading of building pad and paved areas (~$0.10-$0.25/SF = $4k-$11k/acre). Mid: 1,500 CY x $8 + $6k fine grade = $18k. Low: flat site, 750 CY. High: rolling site 3,000+ CY at $10-$12/CY with moisture conditioning.

items.notes: Per acre disturbed. Import/export of surplus or deficit soil is extra (import-fill, export-haul); rock is extra (rock-excavation).

items.name: Erosion & sediment control (SWPPP measures for duration of construction)

cost.method: Assembled per acre disturbed: perimeter silt fence ~400-800 LF/acre (perimeter per acre falls as site size grows) at FDOT sediment barrier $2.26/LF (e6) to ArDOT silt fence $3.36/LF (e7) = $1k-$2.7k; inlet protection 1-3 per acre at FDOT $164.67 each = $0.2k-$0.5k; temporary seeding at ArDOT $775.94/acre (e7) / MDT seeding $769.04/acre (e8); construction entrance, concrete washout and inspection/maintenance allowance $0.5k-$2k. Mid ~$3,000/acre.

items.notes: Excludes permanent stabilization (sod/seed in landscaping block) and permanent detention (stormwater block). NPDES permit/SWPPP preparation is a soft cost.

items.name: Site development, typical commercial pad - all-in on-site (grading, utilities, paving, storm, lighting, landscaping)

cost.method: Bottom-up per gross acre of a typical retail/office/industrial pad with ~25% building footprint, ~55% paved, ~20% landscape: mass grading $18k + erosion control $3k; asphalt paving 0.55 x 4,840 SY = 2,660 SY x $45 = $120k; curb & gutter ~600 LF x $38 = $23k; on-site storm (inlets, pipe) ~$30k; on-site water/sewer/fire services ~$20k; site lighting ~$15k; landscaping & irrigation 0.20 x 43,560 SF x $5 = $44k; walks/signage/striping ~$8k -> ~$281k. Mid rounded to $260k (≈$6.00/SF of site) because many pads have less landscaping; low $150k (≈$3.45/SF: flat site, gravel/minimal landscaping, short utility runs); high $400k (≈$9.20/SF: more paving, concrete, irrigation and storm structures). Excludes detention (stormwater block), off-site work, retaining walls and rock.

items.notes: Use when the user does not itemize site work. Per GROSS site acre (including building footprint). Do not stack with the individual paving/utility/landscaping items for the same area.

items.name: Site development, difficult site - all-in on-site (significant cut/fill, walls, import/export, detention, heavy paving)

cost.method: site-development-light mid ($260k) plus typical difficult-site adders per acre: extra earthwork/import or export 3,000-5,000 CY x $25-$30/CY (import-fill / export-haul mids) = $75k-$150k; retaining walls ~150-300 SF of face x $45-$95/SF = $10k-$30k; detention/water quality ~$40k-$80k (stormwater block); heavier pavement sections / concrete truck areas +$30k-$60k; rock allowance $0-$100k -> $415k-$680k; mid $550k (≈$12.60/SF), high $850k (≈$19.50/SF) for hillside or poor-soil sites.

items.notes: Hillside, poor soils, or tight urban sites requiring import/export and walls. Excludes off-site improvements.

items.name: Rock excavation (rippable to blasting, incl. load & on-site placement)

cost.method: No current public rock-excavation unit price was captured in this session (WVDOT 2025 publishes rock borrow excavation but its PDF text was not machine-readable). Derived as a multiple of common excavation: DOT common excavation runs $6.81-$18.51/CY (e3, e5); rippable rock typically costs ~3-5x common excavation ($25-$40/CY) and drill-and-blast rock ~6-15x ($60-$120/CY) owing to drilling, blasting, vibration monitoring and secondary breaking. Mid $60 = blend assuming roughly half rippable / half blasted.

items.notes: Apply only to the rock volume identified by geotechnical borings. Trench rock for utilities runs at the high end.

items.name: Imported fill / borrow (furnished, hauled, placed and compacted)

cost.method: FDOT borrow excavation, truck measure $38.31/CY (52 contracts, e3); MDT unclassified borrow $14.30/CY and special borrow (neat line) $29.21/CY (e4). Mid $30 = midpoint of MDT special borrow and FDOT borrow; low = MDT common borrow rounded; high = select/structural fill hauled >15 miles in metro markets.

items.notes: Measured in compacted place; structural select fill at the high end.

items.name: Export & haul-off of surplus soil (load, haul, dump fees; clean soil)

cost.method: No direct public unit price captured. Derived: excavate/load ~$5-$8/CY (FDOT regular excavation $6.81/CY, e3), truck haul 10-25 miles round trip ~$6-$20/CY (18-20 CY trucks at $110-$150/hr, 2-4 loads/hr), and receiving-site tipping fee $0-$15/CY for clean fill -> $12-$45; mid $25. Contaminated soil is in the demolition-remediation block.

items.notes: Clean, non-hazardous soil only. Dense urban sites with long hauls run at the high end.
